newsitem.title: UK: Two Turks arrested in big British heroin haul.
newsitem.headline: Two Turks arrested in big British heroin haul.

text.p: Customs officers have seized heroin with a street value of 20 million pounds ($33.8 million) hidden in the bulkheads of two luxury speedboats shipped to Britain from Turkey, a customs spokesman said on Saturday.
He said two Turks had been arrested over the haul, which took the amount of heroin seized in Britain in the past three months to more than one tonne -- more than was discovered in the whole of 1996.

In a separate swoop in Bradford, northern England, customs arrested three Asian men and seized 35 kg of heroin that investigators from Britain and the Pakistani Nacotics Board had tracked since it was taken into Pakistan from Afghanistan.
"This will have a major imact on heroin supply in the north of England," Pat Cadogan, assistant chief investigations officer of Customs and Excise, said in a statement.
